content: Fosaprepitant interacts with various drugs by modulating the activity of hepatic and intestinal enzyme CYP3A4 metabolism. Below are the detailed interactions and recommendations for monitoring or adjusting therapy: 1. Dexamethasone: Decreases the level or effect of fosaprepitant by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor closely. 2. DHEA (herbal supplement): Increases the level or effect of fosaprepitant by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor closely. 3. Diazepam: Fosaprepitant increases the level or effect of diazepam by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor closely. 4. Dichlorphenamide: Both fosaprepitant and dichlorphenamide decrease serum potassium levels. Use caution and monitor potassium levels. 5. Dienogest/Estradiol Valerate: Fosaprepitant increases the level or effect of these hormones by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Monitor for adverse effects such as nausea, irregular uterine bleeding, breast tenderness, and headache. Use caution and monitor closely. 6. Diltiazem: Fosaprepitant increases the level or effect of diltiazem by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor closely. 7. Doxorubicin and Doxorubicin Liposomal: Fosaprepitant increases the level or effect of these drugs by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor closely. 8. Dronedarone: Increases the level or effect of fosaprepitant by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor closely. 9. Duvelisib: Increases the level or effect of fosaprepitant by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Modify therapy and monitor closely. 10. Efavirenz: Decreases the level or effect of fosaprepitant by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor closely. 11. Elagolix: Decreases the level or effect of fosaprepitant by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Elagolix is a weak-to-moderate CYP3A4 inducer. Modify therapy and monitor closely. Consider increasing the dose of CYP3A4 substrates if needed. 12. Eletriptan: Fosaprepitant increases the level or effect of eletriptan by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor closely. 13. Elvitegravir/Cobicistat/Emtricitabine/Tenofovir DF: Increases levels of fosaprepitant by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Modify therapy and monitor closely. Cobicistat is a CYP3A4 inhibitor and contraindicated with CYP3A4 substrates that have serious or life-threatening risks at elevated plasma concentrations. 14. Encorafenib: Fosaprepitant interacts with encorafenib by modulating CYP3A4 metabolism. Encorafenib both inhibits and induces CYP3A4 at clinically relevant plasma concentrations. Coadministration may increase toxicity or reduce efficacy of sensitive CYP3A4 substrates. Use caution and monitor closely. 15. Erlotinib: Fosaprepitant increases the level or effect of erlotinib by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor closely. 16. Eslcarbazepine Acetate: Decreases the level or effect of fosaprepitant by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor closely. 17. Estradiol, Conjugated Estrogens, Esterified Estrogens, and Estropipate: Fosaprepitant increases the level or effect of these estrogens by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor closely. Estrogens are CYP3A4 substrates, and their efficacy in hormone replacement therapy may be reduced. 18. Etonogestrel: Fosaprepitant increases the level or effect of etonogestrel by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor closely. 19. Etoposide: Fosaprepitant increases the level or effect of etoposide by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor closely. 20. Etravirine: Fosaprepitant increases the level or effect of etravirine by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism, while etravirine decreases the level or effect of fosaprepitant by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor closely. 21. Fedratinib: Increases the level or effect of fosaprepitant by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor closely. Adjust doses of CYP3A4 substrates as necessary. 22. Felodipine: Fosaprepitant increases the level or effect of felodipine by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor closely. 23. Fesoterodine: Fosaprepitant increases the level or effect of fesoterodine by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor closely. 24. Finerinone: Fosaprepitant increases the level or effect of finerinone by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Modify therapy and monitor closely. Monitor serum potassium during initiation and dosage adjustment of either finerinone or moderate CYP3A4 inhibitors. Adjust finerinone dosage as needed. 25. Fluconazole: Increases the level or effect of fosaprepitant by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor closely. 26. Fludrocortisone: Fosaprepitant increases the level or effect of fludrocortisone by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism, while fludrocortisone decreases the level or effect of fosaprepitant by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor closely. 27. Fosamprenavir: Fosaprepitant increases the level or effect of fosamprenavir by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor closely. 28. Fosphenytoin: Decreases the level or effect of fosaprepitant by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor closely. 29. Gepirone: Fosaprepitant increases the level or effect of gepirone by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Modify therapy and monitor closely. Reduce gepirone dose by 50% when used concomitantly with a moderate CYP3A4 inhibitor. 30. Grapefruit: Increases the level or effect of fosaprepitant by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor closely. 31. Griseofulvin: Decreases the level or effect of fosaprepitant by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor closely. 32. Guanfacine: Fosaprepitant increases the level or effect of guanfacine by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Modify therapy and monitor closely. Strong or moderate CYP3A4 inhibitors significantly increase guanfacine plasma concentrations. For extended-release guanfacine, reduce the dosage to half the recommended dose if coadministered. Specific recommendations for immediate-release guanfacine are not available. 33. Hydrocortisone: Fosaprepitant increases the level or effect of hydrocortisone by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism, while hydrocortisone decreases the level or effect of fosaprepitant by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor closely. 34. Hydroxyprogesterone Caproate (DSC): Fosaprepitant increases the level or effect of hydroxyprogesterone caproate by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor closely. 35. Ifosfamide: Fosaprepitant decreases the effects of ifosfamide by modulating CYP3A4 metabolism. Monitor for ifosfamide neurotoxicity (e.g., visual and auditory hallucinations, somnolence, confusion, delirium) and decreased efficacy. Use caution and monitor closely. 36. Iloperidone: Fosaprepitant increases the level or effect of iloperidone by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism, while iloperidone increases the level of fosaprepitant. Iloperidone is a time-dependent CYP3A inhibitor and may increase plasma levels of drugs eliminated by CYP3A4. Use caution and monitor closely. 37. Imipramine: Fosaprepitant increases the level or effect of imipramine by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor closely. 38. Indinavir: Fosaprepitant increases the level or effect of indinavir by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism, while indinavir increases the level of fosaprepitant. Use caution and monitor closely. 39. Irinotecan and Irinotecan Liposomal: Fosaprepitant increases the level or effect of irinotecan by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor closely. 40. Isavuconazonium Sulfate: Fosaprepitant decreases the level or effect of isavuconazonium sulfate by modulating CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor closely. 41. Isoniazid: Increases the level or effect of fosaprepitant by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor closely. 42. Istradefylline: Increases the level or effect of fosaprepitant by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Istradefylline 40 mg/day increased peak levels and AUC of CYP3A4 substrates in clinical trials, but this effect was not observed with 20 mg/day. Consider dose reduction of sensitive CYP3A4 substrates. Use caution and monitor closely. 43. Ivosidenib: Fosaprepitant increases the level or effect of ivosidenib by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Coadministration with moderate CYP3A4 inhibitors may increase ivosidenib plasma concentrations, increasing the risk of QTc prolongation. Monitor for increased risk of QTc interval prolongation. Use caution and monitor closely. 44. Ixabepilone: Fosaprepitant increases the level or effect of ixabepilone by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor closely. 45. Lapatinib: Fosaprepitant increases the level or effect of lapatinib by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor closely. 46. Larotrectinib: Increases the level or effect of fosaprepitant by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor closely. 47. Lefamulin: Fosaprepitant increases the level or effect of lefamulin by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Monitor for adverse effects if lefamulin is coadministered with moderate CYP3A inhibitors. Use caution and monitor closely. 48. Lenacapavir: Increases the level or effect of fosaprepitant by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Lenacapavir (a moderate CYP3A4 inhibitor) may increase CYP3A4 substrates initiated within 9 months after the last SC dose of lenacapavir, increasing the risk of adverse reactions. Use caution and monitor closely. 49. Letermovir: Increases levels of fosaprepitant by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor closely. 50. Levamlodipine: Fosaprepitant increases the level or effect of levamlodipine by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Modify therapy and monitor closely. Coadministration with moderate and strong CYP3A inhibitors increases systemic exposure to amlodipine and may require dose reduction. Monitor for symptoms of hypotension and edema to determine the need for dose adjustment. 51. Levonorgestrel Oral/Ethinyl Estradiol/Ferrous Bisglycinate: Fosaprepitant decreases the level or effect of these hormonal contraceptives by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Modify therapy and monitor closely. The efficacy of hormonal contraceptives may be reduced. Use an alternative or backup method of contraception when enzyme inducers are used with combined hormonal contraceptives (CHCs), and continue backup contraception for 28 days after discontinuing the enzyme inducer to ensure contraceptive reliability. 52. Linagliptin: Fosaprepitant increases the level or effect of linagliptin by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor closely. Alternative treatments are strongly recommended when linagliptin is to be administered with a CYP3A4 inducer. 53. Lopinavir: Fosaprepitant increases the level or effect of lopinavir by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism, while lopinavir increases the level of fosaprepitant. Use caution and monitor closely. 54. Loratadine: Fosaprepitant increases the level or effect of loratadine by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor closely. 55. Lorlatinib: Decreases the level or effect of fosaprepitant by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor closely. 56. Lumateperone: Fosaprepitant increases the level or effect of lumateperone by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Modify therapy and monitor closely. Reduce lumateperone dose to 21 mg/day if coadministered with moderate CYP3A4 inhibitors. 57. Lume Fantrine: Fosaprepitant increases the level or effect of lume fantrine by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor closely. 58. Lurasidone: Fosaprepitant increases levels of lurasidone by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Modify therapy and monitor closely. The manufacturer recommends decreasing the starting dose of lurasidone to 20 mg/day and the maximum daily dose to 80 mg when coadministered with moderate CYP3A4 inhibitors. Concurrent use may increase the risk of lurasidone-related adverse reactions. 59. Maraviroc: Fosaprepitant increases the level or effect of maraviroc by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor closely. 60. Marijuana: Increases the level or effect of fosaprepitant by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor closely. 61. Mavacamten: Fosaprepitant increases the level or effect of mavacamten by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Modify therapy and monitor closely. Initiation of moderate CYP3A4 inhibitors may require decreased mavacamten dose. 62. Mavorixafor: Fosaprepitant increases the level or effect of mavorixafor by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Modify therapy and monitor closely. Monitor for mavorixafor adverse effects if coadministered with a moderate CYP3A4 inhibitor. If necessary, reduce mavorixafor daily dose. 63. Mefloquine: Fosaprepitant increases the level or effect of mefloquine by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor closely.
